name: Kansas
summary: Statutes: kslegislature.gov serves one K.S.A. section per constructible URL ('2026 Kansas Statutes', script and WebFetch ok); ksrevisor.gov has the same text plus long annotations; Justia is the tier-2 fallback (script bot-walled, WebFetch ok). Constitution: ksrevisor.gov per-section pages. Court rules: kscourts.gov per-rule PDFs (index-anchored) and the 712-page 2026 rulebook; civil procedure and evidence are K.S.A. chapter 60. Case law: searchdro.kscourts.gov slip-opinion PDFs (GUID URLs, located via list pages; script ok, WebFetch gated), official pagination and petition-for-review dispositions in the advance-sheet PDFs (2024-2026 only); Justia constructible by docket. K.A.R. and Kansas Register moved to the JavaScript app rules.ks.gov (unreadable); LII mirrors K.A.R.

citation_map.notes: Kansas style cites statutes as 'K.S.A. 60-513' (no section sign) and supplements as 'K.S.A. 2023 Supp. 60-513'; Bluebook uses 'Kan. Stat. Ann. § 60-513'. Section numbers may carry a comma (79-32,117: article 32, section 117) or letters (60-513a, chapter 82a); see pattern_rules for the URL split. Rules of civil procedure (K.S.A. 60-201 et seq.) and evidence (K.S.A. 60-401 et seq.) are statutes and route to the K.S.A. rows. Supreme Court rules are cited 'Supreme Court Rule 6.02(a)(5) (2024 Kan. S. Ct. R. at 36)'; bare 'Supreme Court Rule N' / 'Rule 6.02' is shared with other states (Illinois, Missouri) so it is context_required, while the '(YYYY Kan. S. Ct. R. at N)' parenthetical, 'Kan. Sup. Ct. R.' and 'KRPC' are distinctive. Rule 6.08 (not 6.02) governs citation form; Rule 7.04 governs unpublished opinions; Rule 8.03 petitions for review; KRPC is Rule 240. Constitution articles are arabic ('art. 3, § 1') and the Bill of Rights is cited separately. Kansas cites cases 'Hilburn v. Enerpipe Ltd., 309 Kan. 1127, 442 P.3d 509 (2019)' and history 'rev. denied 317 Kan. 846 (2023)'; unpublished: 'No. 125,754, 2024 WL 3548780 (Kan. App. 2024) (unpublished opinion)'. Docket numbers are shared by both courts and written with a comma (context_required). No public-domain citation. CourtListener ids from memory, unverified. Supreme Court rules can have three decimals and a letter (7.041, 7.041A, 7.042, 7.043): capture the full number; 7.041 is not 7.04. A WL cite that also carries 'No. 127,524' matches the context_required docket pattern too; route by the WL pattern.

sources.title: Kansas Statutes (K.S.A.) on the Kansas Legislature site
sources.publisher: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes / Kansas Legislature
sources.official_status_evidence: Revisor FAQ (https://www.ksrevisor.gov/questions.html): 'An unofficial version of the K.S.A. is available online'; the official set is the printed K.S.A. and cumulative supplements distributed by the Secretary of State (K.S.A. 77-138).
sources.coverage: All K.S.A. chapters (1-84 plus lettered chapters), current text with history line; sidebar lists bills affecting the section. Constitution chapters 092/093 are not linked from the chapter list.

access.pattern_rules: {chapter} = K.S.A. chapter zero-padded to 3 digits, keeping any letter suffix (60 -> 060, 8 -> 008, 82a -> 082a). Split the part after the hyphen into article and section: if it contains a comma ('79-32,117', '40-2,105') the article is before the comma and the section after it; otherwise the section is the LAST TWO DIGITS and the article is everything before them (513 -> art 5 / sec 13; 5402 -> 54 / 02; 1567 -> 15 / 67; 2101 -> 21 / 01). {article} = article zero-padded to 3 digits; {section} = section zero-padded to 4 digits plus any trailing letter(s) (60-513a -> 0013a). Drop subsections '(a)(4)' and the 'YYYY Supp.' edition marker before building. Verified: 60-513 -> 060_005_0013, 21-5402 -> 021_054_0002, 79-32,117 -> 079_032_0117, 60-513a -> 060_005_0013a, 82a-701 -> 082a_007_0001. The biennium segment (b2025_26) only changes the bills sidebar: b2023_24 still serves the 2026 text, so there is no historical version by path. The old /li/b2025_26/statute/... path redirects here. Section PDF: https://kslegislature.gov/media/statute/{chapter}_000_0000_chapter/{chapter}_{article}_0000_article/{chapter}_{article}_{section}_section/{chapter}_{article}_{section}_k.pdf (linked from the page; not probed). Article index: .../{chapter}_{article}_0000_article/ lists 'NN-NNN - title' for every section.

automation.notes: Pages are ~4-9K chars of text including a long site menu; statute body follows the 'Prev Article N. - TITLE Next' line and ends at 'History:'. The bill sidebar ('Measures Affecting This Section') precedes the body and quotes bill titles: do not quote it as statute text.

currency.where: heading above the body on every section page; footer shows data refresh time

hazards: unofficial online text: cite the K.S.A. volume or 'K.S.A. YYYY Supp.' edition, not the web page
bill sidebar ('Measures Affecting This Section', including bills only 'As Introduced') sits above the statute body
biennium path segment does not select a historical statute version
comma-numbered sections (79-32,117) and lettered chapters/sections (82a-701, 60-513a) need the pattern_rules split

access.navigation: Advance Sheets page -> 'Volume 321, No. 2' link -> PDF under https://www.kscourts.gov/KSCourts/media/KsCourts/advance-sheets/ (SupremeCourtVol{vol}No{n}.pdf or CourtofAppealsVol{vol}No{n}.pdf, but some names carry a '_1' suffix, e.g. SupremeCourtVol320No2_1.pdf, CourtofAppealsVol65No3_1.pdf: ALWAYS take the URL from the link, never build it). Both courts' links have the same text form; tell them apart by volume range (Kan. 320-322 vs Kan. App. 2d 65-66) or the URL prefix. The table of cases near the front gives the starting page.

automation.notes: 282-page / 657K-char PDFs: beyond WebFetch; use fetch_doc.py grep for the running heads 'VOL. {vol} SUPREME COURT OF KANSAS {page}' or 'VOL. {vol} COURT OF APPEALS OF KANSAS {page}'.

hazards: only the most recent volumes are online; older Kan. / Kan. App. 2d volumes are not free on kscourts.gov
running heads give the official page: 'VOL. 321 SUPREME COURT OF KANSAS 261' (Kan.) and 'VOL. 66 COURT OF APPEALS OF KANSAS 699' (Kan. App. 2d)

sources.coverage: Each advance sheet lists title, Court of Appeals docket number, disposition (Granted/Denied), date and where reported below (Kan. App. 2d cite or 'Unpublished'). Online only for the advance sheets still posted (vol. 320-322).

access.navigation: Advance Sheets page -> Supreme Court volume PDF -> fetch_doc.py grep for the Court of Appeals docket number with comma ('127,118') or 'PETITIONS FOR REVIEW OF DECISIONS OF THE COURT OF APPEALS' (table follows the case index; its PDF page varies by issue: p. 32 in 321 No. 2, p. 12 in 322 No. 2). Take the PDF URL from the link (names may carry '_1')..

automation.notes: Searchable by docket number, not only party name.

hazards: older dispositions (before vol. 320) are not online here
